module: Node "Quat" (repeat_instant). Builds a quaternion from the pins x, y, z, w (0 by default) and writes it as a {x,y,z,w} table on the value pin (quat).
notes: The quaternion is not normalized; with all pins at 0 you get (0,0,0,0), which is invalid.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

work.desc: Composes the quaternion and writes the table.

drawMiddle.desc: Draws the central content of the node in the editor.
